title: GallarDesign: see your website first, pay only if you love it
description: A Cebu web studio that builds your website free in 3 working days. Pay once from ₱18,000 only if you love it. Published prices, and you own everything.
heroHeadline: See your website first. Pay only if you love it.
heroText: GallarDesign is Cebu's honest, AI-powered web studio. We build your website in 3 working days before you pay a peso. Our prices are on this page, and you own everything.
servicesIntro: Everything a small business site needs to win customers, without a deposit or a locked-in contract.
reasonsHeading: AI-first, in ways you can check

reasons.title: A free preview in 3 working days
reasons.text: A designer leads, and AI does the repetitive build work. You see a real site in days, not months.

reasons.title: Edits by chat
reasons.text: Send a Messenger or Viber message. On Care Plus, it's done within 1 working day.

reasons.title: Ready for AI search
reasons.text: Clean structure and schema, so ChatGPT, Gemini and Google's AI answers can find and cite your business.

reasons.title: Honest about AI
reasons.text: We tell you what AI did and what a person did. Real photos of your business, never AI-made people.

faqs.question: Is the preview really free?
faqs.answer: Yes. We build your site and show it to you before you pay anything. If you don't love it, you owe nothing. We take up to 4 free previews a month, one per business, and we start once we have your logo, photos and services.

faqs.question: Why one payment instead of a monthly plan?
faqs.answer: Because you should own what you pay for. You pay once, the day you approve the site, and everything moves to you: domain, files and logins. Care is a separate, optional monthly plan you can stop anytime.

faqs.question: What if I have little or no budget?
faqs.answer: Start with a Simple Page for ₱4,990, pay Starter in 3 payments of ₱6,500, or take Starter with ₱0 down at ₱2,490 a month for 12 months, care included.

faqs.question: Do I have to sign up for care?
faqs.answer: No. Care is optional and month to month. Without it, we move your site to a free Cloudflare account in your name and hand everything over. You only pay for your domain.

faqs.question: How do I pay?
faqs.answer: In full by GCash, Maya, bank transfer or card, once you approve the preview. You get an official receipt for every payment.

faqs.question: Do you help churches and ministries?
faqs.answer: Yes. Up to 4 qualified ministries a year get a free website. See the Giving page for who qualifies and how to apply.

ctaText: Tell us about your business. You'll get a reply within one working day, and a preview in 3 working days if it's a fit.
